title: a11y focus tier chain: version history + incident ref
desc: T3 reference for a11y-focus-tier-chain. Version history of SmartSetWindowOrder + the 2026-05-19 FOCUS-STEAL investigation and dispatch.
steps: VERSION HISTORY: v1.0 (2026-05-03) initial SmartSetWindowOrder -- child BringWindowToTop, root rank-2. v1.1 (2026-05-03) MDI child focus also moves root to rank-2. v2.0 (2026-05-03) full OS-level service -- iconic restore, topmost strip, GW_OWNER chain, PlaceRootBehindForeground helper, SuppressFullscreenOpaqueOverlays overlay guard. v2.1 (2026-05-03) SmartSetWindowOrder injected before 10 interactive write actions (invoke, click, type, set-value, set-range, toggle, expand, collapse, select, scroll)

FOCUS-STEAL bug investigation (2026-05-19): if a11y actions still steal focus despite zero-steal rules, audit for VIOLATIONS first -- grep for SetForegroundWindow / SetActiveWindow / AttachThreadInput / SwitchToThisWindow in a11y action paths. Bandaid guard (GetLastInputInfo defer) is defense-in-depth only; the real fix is removing the forbidden API call or routing it through SmartSetWindowOrder. Investigation order: (1) wkfind for forbidden APIs in a11y; (2) git log on offending file to find when the violation was introduced; (3) replace with SmartSetWindowOrder + UIA/Win32 SetFocus; (4) optionally add user-activity guard as belt-and-suspenders

FOCUS-STEAL fix dispatch (2026-05-19 18:40): delegated investigation to Opus subagent. Target: find zero-steal-rule violations (SetForegroundWindow / SetActiveWindow / AttachThreadInput / SwitchToThisWindow in a11y action paths) and replace with SmartSetWindowOrder + UIA/Win32 SetFocus. Defense-in-depth UserActivityGuard (GetLastInputInfo, ~500ms threshold) added only if a legitimate focus-theft path remains. 3 target suggests resolved 2026-05-19
